hero.title: Sri Sri University
hero.summary: Sri Sri University combines agricultural teaching with working farmland at its Cuttack campus. Its documented activities include crop cultivation, beekeeping and mushroom production. The undergraduate agriculture programme appears in the audited ICAR register, while other allied degrees require their own scope checks.

overview.heading: Agricultural study connected with campus food production
paragraphs: The Faculty of Agriculture offers more than one route into agricultural study. University sustainability reporting describes undergraduate agriculture, horticulture, agribusiness and food, nutrition and dietetics, together with postgraduate agricultural disciplines. Applicants should compare the science and business orientation of these qualifications before selecting a course.

The university reports that its farmland contributes produce to campus food services. A 2026 sustainability submission describes fruit, vegetable and cereal cultivation, together with apiculture and mushroom units. These activities place agricultural production within a working campus food system, while the different science and business degrees allow students to choose an emphasis suited to their interests.

admissions.heading: Planning an agriculture application
admissions.intro: SSU’s admission guideline page describes online applications and a non-refundable INR 500 application charge for Indian nationals. Its displayed 2026-27 dates are internally inconsistent, so obtain the applicable selection notice and deadline directly.
eligibility_points: The undated Agriculture and Horticulture fact sheets specify PCB/PCM science with at least 50%.
Agribusiness has a source conflict: its official course fact sheet specifies PCB/PCM science, while NTA’s 2025 listing accepted any 10+2 stream. Confirm the intended intake before applying.

steps.text: The guidelines specify an online application and a separate form for each programme.

campus.heading: Farmland and small agricultural enterprises
campus.intro: University sustainability evidence describes 40 acres of agricultural land, apiculture and mushroom production. Its report associates farm output with campus kitchens and local food procurement.

student_services.name: Student grievance channel
student_services.description: The published student support channel is studentgrievance@srisriuniversity.edu.in. Individual dues and receipts are accessed through the university payment system.

faqs.question: Does SSU’s ICAR entry cover all its allied degrees?
faqs.answer: The audited row explicitly lists B.Sc. (Hons.) Agriculture. Horticulture and agribusiness are verified offerings but are not added to that accreditation scope.

faqs.question: What science subjects did SSU require for agriculture in 2025?
faqs.answer: The NTA listing states PCB or PCM at 10+2 level with at least 50%. Later intake rules need confirmation.

faqs.question: Is there an agribusiness option for non-science students?
faqs.answer: The NTA 2025 listing accepted any 10+2 stream with at least 50%, but SSU’s undated Agribusiness course fact sheet specifies science with PCB/PCM. Because those sources differ, a non-science applicant should obtain the intended intake rule directly.

faqs.question: What practical agricultural units are documented?
faqs.answer: SSU reports farmland, an apiculture unit and mushroom production in its sustainability evidence.

faqs.question: Are the tuition figures on this page current intake fees?
faqs.answer: The programme fact sheets quote INR85,000 for Agriculture, INR68,000 for Horticulture and INR63,000 for Agribusiness per semester, but do not identify an intake year. These are undated official amounts rather than confirmed 2026/2027 prices.
